name: oot_enemy_gohma_larva
author: Skijer
description: Ocarina of Time's Gohma Larva in Majora's Mask: it waits as an egg, hatches when you come close and leaps at you. Deku Nuts stun it and a shield push knocks it back. Custom enemy oot.gohma_larva and its soul soul.oot.gohma_larva. Uses OoT Asset Loader resources.
